name: ViViD
description: The BTT ViViD is a commercial multi-color management system using a selector-based design with a rotating selector mechanism and a separate buffer unit. During a filament change, the system unloads the current filament via high-speed retraction through the selector back to the buffer, rotates the selector to the new slot, and performs high-speed loading. The unit doubles as a filament dryer box with a heated chamber (up to 60C, typical range 45-55C depending on material). It connects to the printer's Klipper host via USB and supports RFID tag reading for open standard protocols.

mechanicalSpecs.bufferType: Included Buffer module (connected via PTFE, min 60mm bend radius)

features: Filament cutting mechanism (supports Filametrix and A4T cutters)
Automatic filament loading with gate/entry/outlet sensors
Purge and brush nozzle cleaning system
Compatible with Happy Hare as alternative driver
Supports Blobifier purge system (Spoolman integration via Happy Hare only)
